meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 添加本地监控仪表盘:安装依赖、复制推送模块、在 main() 中接入启动逻辑、配置环境变量并重启服务。之后定期推送数据与日志,仪表盘展示会话、用户、token 用量等。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘(如说 add-dashboard 或“加个仪表盘”)时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘
say.note: Claude 会按步骤安装、接线并配置。

say.text: 用 add-dashboard 技能给 NanoClaw 加个运行面板
say.note: 会安装插件、改代码、重启服务。

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: installs the dependency, copies the pusher module, wires it into main(), sets env vars, and restarts the service. NanoClaw then periodically pushes data/logs; the dashboard shows sessions, users, token usage, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, e.g. mentions add-dashboard or 'add a dashboard'.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude installs, wires, and configures it.

say_en.text: Use the add-dashboard skill to add a runtime panel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It installs the plugin, edits code, and restarts.
